summary.lead: Official summary (Congressional Research Service, Reported to House):

blocks.text: This bill requires the authorized monument honoring Thomas Paine to be located in Area 1 of the National Mall, which is reserved for commemorative works of preeminent historical and lasting significance to the United States. Thomas Paine was a philosopher and writer whose pamphlet, Common Sense, advocated for American independence from Great Britain.

This bill would require the approved monument honoring Thomas Paine to be placed in Area 1 of the National Mall. That area is set aside for memorials of exceptional historical importance and lasting significance to the country.
Thomas Paine was a philosopher and writer. His pamphlet, Common Sense, argued that the American colonies should become independent from Great Britain.
